preheader: Treasury yields hit 2002 highs, Paramount clears its big merger, and AI voice startup ElevenLabs doubles its valuation.

lead.headline: 10-year Treasury yield hits its highest level since 2002
lead.body: U.S. Treasury yields climbed on Thursday as a global bond sell-off deepened ahead of upcoming jobs data. The benchmark 10-year Treasury yield rose 4 basis points to 5.3338%, reaching levels not seen since April 2002.
lead.why: Higher government bond yields raise the cost of borrowing for everyone else, which directly impacts corporate finance, company valuations, and capital markets you study in Merage.

stories.headline: Paramount clears $110 billion Warner Bros. Discovery acquisition
stories.body: A federal judge cleared Paramount's massive $110 billion acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery to move forward. The Hollywood megadeal has faced sharp public criticism over job cuts and industry consolidation.
stories.why: This is a textbook mega-merger. Keep an eye on how they handle post-merger integration and synergies in media, which you will study in corporate strategy.

stories.headline: South Korea outlines potential $200 billion U.S. investment plan
stories.body: President Trump announced plans for up to $200 billion in South Korean investment into the U.S. economy. The package includes nuclear power plants, a natural gas facility, and the Alaska LNG project, though full participation is not yet finalized.
stories.why: Cross-border capital flows of this size reshape industrial sectors and create massive opportunities for consulting firms advising on infrastructure and energy projects.

stories.headline: OpenAI accuses Moonshot AI of mass data extraction
stories.body: OpenAI disclosed that thousands of attempts by users associated with Chinese rival Moonshot AI tried to extract hidden reasoning data from its GPT systems. The effort sought to decipher how OpenAI models work through complex problems.
stories.why: As AI companies race for dominance, protecting intellectual property and proprietary algorithms is becoming a massive legal and strategic battleground for tech startups.

stories.headline: OpenAI and Synopsys partner to build chip design AI model
stories.body: OpenAI and Synopsys announced a multi-year partnership to create GPT-Synopsys, a specialized AI model for semiconductor design. The tool will combine OpenAI's models with Synopsys's electronic design automation software.
stories.why: Vertical AI applications that integrate deeply into complex industrial engineering workflows represent some of the highest-value B2B software opportunities today.

stories.headline: McKinsey highlights AI shifting millions of workers into new careers by 2035
stories.body: A new report from the McKinsey Global Institute outlines how artificial intelligence will force millions of U.S. workers into new career paths over the next decade. Rather than predicting mass unemployment, the study emphasizes a major shift in required workplace skills.
stories.why: Understanding how automation alters job roles will help you target resilient industries and future-proof your own career path coming out of business school.

stories.headline: Ford CEO says AI will change entry-level programming and finance roles
stories.body: Ford CEO Jim Farley stated that while blue-collar workers can use AI as a companion, entry-level programming, finance spreadsheet work, and call center jobs are definitely going to be changed and eliminated.
stories.why: If entry-level technical and financial tasks are being automated, your competitive edge in early internships will rely heavily on strategic thinking and high-level problem solving.

stories.headline: Kei Nishikori plays final match of career at Japan Open
stories.body: Former world number four Kei Nishikori fell 6-4, 6-4 to Frances Tiafoe in the first round of the Japan Open. An adoring Tokyo crowd rose to salute the Japanese trailblazer in his final tournament before retirement.

stories.headline: Carlos Alcaraz defends best-of-five sets for Grand Slam tournaments
stories.body: Carlos Alcaraz voiced support for keeping Grand Slam matches at best-of-five sets to preserve tennis history. He argued that the tour should instead reform the crowded calendar to reduce player burnout.

term.name: Basis Point
term.definition: A basis point is one-hundredth of a percentage point, commonly used in finance to express changes in interest rates or bond yields. When the 10-year Treasury yield rises by 4 basis points, it means an increase of 0.04%. It is a precise way to talk about small shifts in financial markets without causing confusion with regular percentages.

serve.headline: ElevenLabs doubled its valuation to $22 billion following a $300 million employee tender offer.
serve.body: The AI voice generation startup completed a major employee share buyback led by Wellington and T. Rowe Price. The transaction pushed its valuation to double what it was in February.
